fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects child processes of "dfsvc" which indicates a ClickOnce deployment execution.
fields.name: ClickOnce Deployment Execution - Dfsvc.EXE Child Process
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\dfsvc.exe" and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Apps\\2.0\\"))
